content.title: Why UniFirst (UNF) Shares Are Plunging Today
content.summary: Shares of workplace uniform provider UniFirst (NYSE:UNF) fell 5.9% in the afternoon session after the company released disappointing financial guidance for its 2026 fiscal year, which overshadowed its fourth-quarter results.

content.title: UNF Q3 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Persist Amid Strategic Investments and Tariff Headwinds
content.summary: Workplace uniform provider UniFirst (NYSE:UNF) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 4% year on year to $614.4 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.49 billion at the midpoint came in 0.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $2.23 per share was 7.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: UniFirst (UNF): Margin Expansion Reinforces Bullish Narrative on Value and Profitability
content.summary: UniFirst (UNF) posted a net profit margin of 6.2%, a solid improvement over last year’s 5.5%, as earnings growth came in at 17.3% for the year. That pace outstrips its five-year average annual earnings growth of just 0.6%, marking clear momentum on the bottom line.
